meta.name: defi-protocol-templates
meta.description: Implement DeFi protocols with production-ready templates for staking, AMMs, governance, and flash loans. Use when building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发区块链应用，需要搭建 DeFi 协议
copy.tagline_en: Use production-ready templates to build DeFi protocols

howto.what: 当你要求写 DeFi 智能合约时,Claude 会给出质押奖励、AMM(自动做市商)、治理代币、闪电贷的 Solidity 模板代码,并可按提示读取 references/details.md 里的更多范式。
howto.when: 当你要构建 DeFi 应用或智能合约协议时触发,例如搭建带奖励分配的质押平台、实现 AMM 等。

say.text: 给我一个带奖励分配的质押合约模板
写一个带 0.3% 手续费的简单 AMM 合约
say.note: 输出 SimpleAMM 的流动性增删与兑换代码

say.text: 看看 references/details.md 里还有哪些模板
say.note: 读取该文件获取完整范式库

howto.what_en: When you ask for DeFi smart contracts, Claude outputs Solidity templates for staking rewards, AMMs, governance tokens, and flash loans, and can read references/details.md for more patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build DeFi applications or smart contract protocols, such as a staking platform with reward distribution or an AMM.

say_en.text: Give me a staking contract template with reward distribution
Write a simple AMM contract with a 0.3% fee
say_en.note: Outputs SimpleAMM liquidity and swap code

say_en.text: What other templates are in references/details.md?
say_en.note: Reads that file for the full pattern library
